set system host-name PE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: route-target
parameters.explanation: Route target, for route differentiation in BGP/MPLS VPN.

set protocols l2vpn vfi vfi1.explanation: This command configures a Virtual Forwarding Instance (VFI) for Layer 2 VPN (L2VPN) in Junos, where `[parameter1]` specifies the VFI name.

parameters.name: vfi-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the virtual forwarding example.

vpn-id 1.explanation: Configures the virtual forwarding example of L2VPN (VFI) and its VPN ID.

set protocols mpls label-switched-path l.explanation: Configure the label exchange path (LSP) for MPLS to use the LDP protocol.

parameters.name: lsp-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the label exchange path.

set protocols l2circuit neighbor 1.1.1.1.explanation: Configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) neighbor with the specified IP address (`[parameter1]`) for point-to-point pseudowire connectivity.

interface ge-1/0/0.1.explanation: This command configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) by specifying a neighbor device (`parameter1`) and associating it with a local interface (`parameter2`) for pseudowire establishment.

virtual-circuit-id 1.explanation: The L2 circuit is equipped with neighbours, interfaces and virtual circuit ID.

set protocols bgp group external.explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

family evpn signaling.explanation: Configure the EVPN address of the BGP group.

set protocols ospf area 0.explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface ge-2/0/0.explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.

set protocols evpn source-local-address.explanation: Configure the source local address of the EVPN.

set routing-instances evrf1.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing instance named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing for separate routing tables and protocols within that instance.

parameters.name: routing-instance
parameters.explanation: Name of route example, e.g. net.

bridge-domains bd100.explanation: This command fragment configures a bridge domain (`[parameter2]`) within a specified routing instance (`[parameter1]`) in Junos, enabling Layer 2 bridging for that domain.

parameters.name: bridge-domain
parameters.explanation: The name of the bridge domain.

vlan-id 1.explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for the route example bridge domain.

unit 0.1.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

vlan-id 1.explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.1.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

unit 1.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 1.1.1.1/32.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.
